title: Did you know this resume hack?
description:
Did you know this resume hack??

Let the job description guide your resume. 

When your resume is full of the keywords and skills included in the job description you'll look like the perfect fit! 

It's easy to customize your resume for any job in this tool!  Teal

#resumehelp #resumehack #resumetips
